summary: V19.2 full E2E validation: backend pytest (29 from iter118+119+120) + live smoke (4 new) + UI E2E across client profile consolidation, change-password modal, /empleos?post=1 auto-modal, reels autoplay attrs, and CEO Code Health dashboard. All 33 backend assertions pass against live preview URL. UI tests show every requested testid is wired and functional.

issues: The tabs nav (Photos·Favoritos·About) sits at y≈800 on a 844px viewport — very close to the fixed bottom-nav at y≈800-844. Tabs are tappable but Playwright force-click without JS dispatch missed them ~50% of the time because the bottom-nav row overlaps the tab row's hit area. Recommend bumping bottom padding on the profile content (pb-24) so tabs clear the bottom-nav by at least 16px on small viewports.

action_items: [Minor design] Increase bottom padding on /profile so the tabs (Photos/Favorites/About) clear the fixed mobile bottom-nav by ≥16px — currently they overlap visually on a 390x844 viewport (tap target works but feels cramped).

[Code-quality / hotspot] server.py is 11,413 LOC (flagged by the new code-health dashboard itself as Hotspot #1). Founder priority should be splitting server.py into route modules in upcoming iterations — your own dashboard is screaming this. routes/auth.py (829), routes/community.py (781), routes/user_referrals.py (721) also exceed the 700-LOC guideline.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 11,413 LOC is far past any reasonable per-file budget — surface area for regressions is huge. Treat extraction into route modules as a P0 refactor (auth, users/me, reels, stories, admin/code-health, etc.).

Change-password modal correctly triggers POST /api/auth/forgot-password and renders 'Check your inbox! / Enter the code' CTA — flow is sound. Confirm Resend integration is enabled in prod (currently emails are logged to backend stderr per test_credentials.md).
Cover upload (POST /api/users/me/cover) accepts multipart PNG, persists cover_url, and DELETE cleanly clears it — round-trip verified on the live preview URL.
/api/admin/code-health correctly enforces admin auth (401 unauth), returns commit hash, ruff stats, test counts and hotspots, with verdict='green' on the current build.

Reels <video> tag now ships autoPlay + muted + playsInline + correct src — autoplay attributes match what mobile Safari/Chrome need. Headless Chromium still reports paused=true (autoplay-policy in headless), which is expected.

BottomNav `bottom-nav-account` correctly carries href='/profile' AND aria-current='page' when on /profile — accessible + the Profile icon visually lights up in the screenshot. Earlier duplicate-Profile bug is resolved.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on functionality (all testids found, all flows confirmed; one minor design overlap noted)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md: admin@getamano.com/admin123 (admin) and demo.client@getamano.com/client123 (client). Both authenticate via POST /api/auth/login (200) and persist via JWT cookie. Carlos Demo currently has at least one favorite saved (favorites-list rendered, no empty-state CTA shown).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo accounts. Test uploads a 1x1 PNG cover then DELETEs it for cleanup so no residual data remains on Carlos Demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile tabs nav sits low on mobile (y≈800 of 844 viewport) and overlaps the fixed bottom-nav row visually — Playwright .click(force=True) misses them ~50% of the time, but evaluate(() => el.click()) hits 100%. Use JS-dispatched clicks for any tab interactions in future E2E runs on this page. All testids referenced in the V19.2 spec are present and functional.
